name: wildfire
job: Map land burned in the August 2026 fires through smoke and cloud, from NISAR HH and HV before and after the fire

labels.source: Sentinel-2 burn index: dNBR >= 0.27 burned, dNBR < 0.1 unburned, on land with pre-fire NDVI >= 0.3; composites 20 Jul-20 Aug and 1-30 Sep 2026
labels.notes: Low-severity and ambiguous changes are left out of training, not labelled unburned. Scores measure agreement with optical proxy labels, not field truth or official perimeters

baseline.name: HV drop rule
baseline.metric: burned IoU, held-out spatial test blocks (Sentinel-2 proxy labels)

model.name: U-Net on pre- and post-fire HH/HV composites (3 Passes each)
model.metric: burned IoU, held-out spatial test blocks (Sentinel-2 proxy labels)

extra_scores.name: Gradient-boosted trees
extra_scores.metric: burned IoU, held-out spatial test blocks (Sentinel-2 proxy labels)

extra_scores.name: U-Net, low end of the block-bootstrap 95% interval (23 test blocks)
extra_scores.metric: burned IoU, held-out spatial test blocks (Sentinel-2 proxy labels)

extra_scores.name: HV drop rule, high end of the block-bootstrap 95% interval
extra_scores.metric: burned IoU, held-out spatial test blocks (Sentinel-2 proxy labels)

split: The area is cut into 256 x 256-pixel blocks (5 km) with a 16-pixel buffer, assigned to train, validation and test inside the one fire complex. The Model is chosen on validation burned IoU and its decision threshold (0.875) is set on validation; all three methods are scored on the same test blocks at the true class balance.
limits: One fire complex, one track (109 descending), Passes of 15 Jul to 25 Sep 2026: no demonstrated transfer to another fire or biome (not tested on Washington).

The map covers only land the radar observed that was vegetated before the fire (Sentinel-2 NDVI 0.3 or more, 2 or more clear scenes): 42% of the site has no class (sea, bare or harvested ground, cloudy pre-fire optical). The questions read those pixels as not burned.
Because that area is set by optical images, the map cannot be rerun from radar alone.
Clearing, drought, wet soil and radar geometry (layover and shadow on steep slopes) can look like burning.
The full map includes the training blocks; only the test blocks measure performance.
Scores are uncalibrated; 20 m pixels after 3 x 3 smoothing are not 20 m independent resolution. Not an active-fire or alert product.
